ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota's Somali Community
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Somali community, including the role of Soros-funded witnesses and the response of state and federal authorities.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the flow of funds to identify potential fraudulent activities
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Somali community?
How have state and federal authorities responded to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraudulent activities and shed light on the response of state and federal authorities. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform further investigation.
